name: memo-bank
description:
Connect ChatGPT to your Memo Bank accounts. Retrieve real-time balances, search and filter transactions, access supporting attachments, and upload invoices and receipts directly to the matching transaction.

The Memo Bank MCP server is built for finance teams who want to reconcile and document their banking activity from ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Give me the consolidated cash balance of my 5 companies, by account and by currency.
Have there been any unusual outgoing transfers this month compared to the last six months?
Find all the invoices in my emails from the past month and attach them to their corresponding transactions.
interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to your Memo Bank accounts. Retrieve real-time balances, search and filter transactions, access supporting attachments, and upload invoices and receipts directly to the matching transaction.

The Memo Bank MCP server is built for finance teams who want to reconcile and document their banking activity from ChatGPT.

positive.description: List the bank accounts of the workspace
positive.expected_behavior: Lists every account of the workspace with its name, IBAN, currency and current balance (converted from cents, e.g. 299,500.00 EUR).

positive.description: Reconstruct the balance history of an account over the last 12 months
positive.prompt: Show me the history of my account balance in the past year
positive.expected_behavior: Gets the current balance from list_accounts, fetches the transactions of the past 12 months filtered by account and date range, and rebuilds the balance over time (e.g. month by month), ignoring canceled and rejected transactions. If the workspace has several accounts, asks which one or shows each.
Lists the most recent transactions with date, counterparty, amount (signed by direction, converted from cents), currency, status and account.

positive.description: List the users of the workspace
positive.prompt: List all users in my Memo Bank workspace
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace users with their name, email, role (owner, admin, collaborator) and status, distinguishing removed users from active ones.

positive.description: Retrieve the IBAN of a specific account
positive.prompt: What is the IBAN of my Engineering team account?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the account named "Engineering team account" and returns its main IBAN (FR76 1733 8000 0145 8559 3900 316), without returning a virtual IBAN as the account IBAN.

negative.description: General finance question unrelated to the user banking data
negative.prompt: What is the current ECB main refinancing rate?
Show me the balance of my BNP Paribas account.

negative.description: Request to initiate a transfer, which the app does not support (read-only on money movements)
negative.prompt: Send a 1,500 EUR transfer from my Marketing team account to FR7630006000011234567890189.
